title: Facet source media review
description: What the operator's supplied footage, audio and images actually contain, written at intake to artifacts/source_media_review.json before any planning, so the plan rests on inspection, never on file names. Inspect each file with media_probe (and audio_probe for sound); for video also scene_detect and frame_sample, and look at the frames.

files.description: One entry per supplied file. Empty when nothing was supplied or nothing could be inspected; summary then says so plainly.

reviewed.description: Always true: the file was inspected, not assumed.

technical_probe.description: What media_probe and audio_probe report for the file.

content_summary.description: What the file contains, described from what you saw and heard.

transcript_summary.description: Summary of the speech, when there is speech and a transcript.

transcript_path.description: The transcript or subtitle file (SRT or VTT) the operator supplied, or a narration_timing record made from it. Leave it out when there is none, and say in planning_implications what that rules out.

representative_frames.description: Paths of sampled frames (video and images).

quality_risks.description: Problems that affect planning: low resolution, mono or noisy audio, shaky or dark footage, burned-in text, framing that will not survive a vertical crop.

usable_for.description: What the file can do in the production: hero footage, b-roll, background audio and so on.

moments.description: The strongest complete moments in the file, with the context each needs to stay truthful.

context_needed.description: What must stay around the moment so its meaning is not changed.

summary.description: What the supplied media contains and what it does not, specifically: "45 s of interview footage, no b-roll, mono audio at 44.1 kHz", not "user provided footage".

planning_implications.description: Concrete constraints and opportunities the proposal, script and scene plan must follow: what the material supports, what it cannot carry, what is missing. Each item is actionable.
